_comment: The 5 firmware binaries for the ctadl-rs vs ctadl-souffle head-to-head - DO-NOT-MERGE.
Drawn from operation-mango-public/firmware/7_firmware, the SaTC 7-device corpus behind
Operation Mango's paper Table 3, so these are the same images ../TABLE3_COMPARISON.md used.
Chosen for spread rather than for a favourable result: 3 vendors, 2 architectures, and a
size range of 20K..312K. The daemons are the ones command injection actually lives in -
the Netgear service/init binaries (nvram-getter -> sprintf -> system), D-Link's NVRAM
The upper size bound is set by ctadl-souffle, not by ctadl-rs: Souffle indexes the whole
program eagerly, and the megabyte-class httpd binaries in this corpus are out of reach for
